prediction.diagnostic_role: fixed-source-depth Bayes; does not replace B's training prior

instantaneous.scope: Evaluated positions only; pointwise normal intervals are not a simultaneous band.

cumulative.scope: Evaluated positions only; pointwise normal intervals are not a simultaneous band.

uncertainty: One standard error across all independent source/path draws; paired path sums for cumulative quantities.
primary_estimator: Average over the actual current transition row, then over source/path draws.

numerical_validation.scope: One long path, wider bounds and half-cell grid shift.
